_comment: Phase state machine for the GS-Sim build. Claude reads this at the start of any session to resume autonomously. Each phase advances only when its gate script prints PHASE_N_PASS=true.

0.name: toolchain
0.criteria: gsplat renders; >=100 FPS on 100k synthetic gaussians; rotorpy hover 10s altitude error <0.1m

1.name: scenes
1.criteria: >=2 scenes, PSNR >=26 on held-out views, >=80 FPS at 720p

2.name: drone_gaussian
2.criteria: composited renders show correct occlusion; rendered mask vs projected bbox IoU >=0.6; Claude contact-sheet review passes

3.name: gs_sim_core
3.criteria: run_tracking --backend gs completes 45s front_sweep at >=20 Hz with visible_rate >=0.9

4.name: dataset_and_model
4.criteria: GS-domain val mAP50 >=0.98; mixed GS+Blocks val >=0.95

5.name: performance_figure8
5.criteria: figure8 x 3 predictors all meet standard gates (visible >=0.98, lost=0, p95 <=67.71px)

6.name: final_regression
6.criteria: 27-run matrix (3 scenes x 3 patterns x 3 predictors) complete with report
